channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Mushaharka MLS: Lewandowski iyo Griezmann oo ku biiray Messi liiska ciyaartoyda ugu mushaharka badan
item.description: Ururka ciyaartoyda horyaalka MLS ayaa 19 November soo saaray liiska mushaharka cusub, kaas oo muujinaya in Lionel Messi uu weli yahay ciyaaryahanka ugu mushaharka badan, halka Robert Lewandowski iyo Antoine Griezmann ay galeen kaalimaha sare.

item.title: Napoli: Goolhaye Alex Meret oo laf-dhabarta ka jabay tababarka, muddada uu maqnaanayo lama oga
item.description: Kooxda Napoli ayaa 19 November si rasmi ah u sheegtay in goolhayeheeda Alex Meret uu tababarka ku dhaawacmay, baaritaanno lagu sameeyayna ay muujiyeen inuu ka jabay lafta shanaad ee qaybta hoose ee laf-dhabarta.

item.title: Shirka Berlin: Merz oo yiri qaab Yalta nabad uma keeni karo Ukraine, Trump-na si lama filaan ah ayuu u soo wacay
item.description: Raysal wasaaraha Jarmalka Friedrich Merz ayaa 19 November, kadib shir ay Berlin ku yeesheen xulafada Ukraine, sheegay in “qaab Yalta ah aanu nabad u keeni karin” Ukraine, isagoo kulankii Trump, Putin iyo Xi ku tilmaamay sawir-qaadasho. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa isna si lama filaan ah shirka ugu soo biiray wicitaan telefoon.

item.title: Kenya: Ruto oo sheegay in mucaaradku u diyaar garoobayaan inay IEBC ku eedeeyaan guuldarrada doorashada 2027
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa 19 November sheegay in mucaaradku ay isu diyaarinayaan inay guuldarrada doorashada guud ee 2027 dusha uga tuuraan guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC, xilli xisbigiisa UDA uu isna ku hanjabay inuu qaadacayo shirarka guddiga.

item.title: Shevchenko oo Mudryk ku eedeeyay been-abuur, kana dalbaday inuu raali-gelin bixiyo
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Ukraine (UAF), Andriy Shevchenko, ayaa 19 November ku tilmaamay been-abuur aan sal lahayn eedeymaha uu Mykhailo Mudryk u jeediyay xiriirka ee ku saabsan kiiskiisa daroogada.

item.title: NFL: Denver Broncos iyo Riley Moss oo ku dhow heshiis afar sano ah oo 67 milyan oo doollar ah
item.description: Kooxda Denver Broncos ayaa la sheegay inay ku dhow tahay inay dhammaystirto heshiis kordhin ah oo afar sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay 67 milyan oo doollar, kaas oo ay la gelayso daafaca Riley Moss.

item.title: Lee Kang-in oo sannadkii labaad xiriir ah ku guuleystay abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka caalamiga ah ee Aasiya
item.description: Xiddigga Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo kooxda Atlético Madrid Lee Kang-in ayaa Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Aasiya (AFC) u doortay Ciyaaryahanka Caalamiga ah ee Sannadka ee Aasiya, abaalmarin uu sidoo kale qaatay sannadkii 2025.

item.title: Davis Cup: Talyaaniga oo Matteo Berrettini ugu yeeray booska Simone Bolelli kahor finalka Bologna
item.description: Kabtanka xulka tennis-ka Talyaaniga Filippo Volandri ayaa 19 November liiska kooxda Davis Cup ku daray Matteo Berrettini, isagoo ka saaray ciyaaryahanka labaatiyada Simone Bolelli, kahor tartanka finalka ee lagu qabanayo Bologna.

item.title: FIFA oo diiday in Bilbao iyo San Sebastián ay si wadajir ah u martigeliyaan Koobka Adduunka 2030
item.description: Ururka FIFA ayaa si rasmi ah u diiday soo jeedin ahayd in magaalooyinka Bilbao iyo San Sebastián ee Gobolka Basque ay noqdaan hal xarun oo leh laba garoon xilliga Koobka Adduunka 2030.

item.title: Martín Ojeda oo ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Goolka Sannadka ee MLS 2026, goolkii cidhibta ee uu ka dhaliyay D.C. United
item.description: Xiddigga Argentina iyo kooxda Orlando City Martín Ojeda ayaa 19 November lagu dhawaaqay inuu ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Goolka Sannadka ee horyaalka MLS 2026, goolkii uu cidhibta ku dhaliyay 17 October ee kulankii D.C. United.

item.title: ATP Finals: Ben Shelton oo garaacay Rafael Jodar, kuna dhowaaday wareegga afarta sare
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Mareykanka Ben Shelton ayaa 19 November magaalada Turin ku garaacay Rafael Jodar oo Spain u dhashay, taas oo u dhowaysay inuu u gudbo semi-finalka tartanka ATP Finals.

item.title: Blackpool oo shaqada ka eriday tababaraha Ian Evatt kadib sannad iyo natiijooyin liita
item.description: Kooxda Blackpool ee Ingiriiska ayaa 19 November bayaan rasmi ah ku shaacisay inay kala tageen tababaraheeda Ian Evatt, kadib hal sano oo uu xilka hayay iyo natiijooyin hoose oo kooxdu ku jirtay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay.

item.title: Mainz oo heshiiska daafaca da'da yar Kacper Potulski u kordhisay ilaa 2030
item.description: Kooxda Mainz 05 ee Bundesliga ayaa 19 November shaacisay inay heshiiska daafaca dhexe ee Poland u dhashay Kacper Potulski, oo 19 jir ah, u kordhisay laba sano oo kale, isagoo hadda kooxda la joogi doona ilaa 2030.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka U-17: Faransiiska oo 3-1 ku garaacay Haiti, Loan Merrifield oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: Xulka Faransiiska ee da'da ka yar 17 sano ayaa 19 November magaalada Doha ee Qatar ku garaacay Haiti 3-1 kulankoodii ugu horreeyay ee Koobka Adduunka, iyadoo Loan Merrifield uu dhaliyay laba gool.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka U-17: Mozambique oo kulankeedii ugu horreeyay 4-0 ku garaacday Denmark
item.description: Xulka Mozambique ee da'da ka yar 17 sano ayaa 19 November Qatar ku garaacay Denmark 4-0, kulankii ugu horreeyay ee ay abid ka ciyaarto Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA ee heerkan.

item.title: HANTIDHOWRKA GUUD EE SOOMAALIYA OO XOOJINAYA HUFNAANTA IYO LA XISAABTANKA MAAMULKA KHAYRAADKA DABIICIGA AH EE DALKA
item.description: Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta qabtay kulan aqoon-is-weydaarsi ah oo diiradda lagu saaray maareynta, soo saarista iyo maamulka khayraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalka, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay xoojinta hufnaanta, isla-xisaabtanka iyo ilaalinta hantida qaranka.

item.title: Manchester United: dakhliga oo kordhay, balse khasaaraha saddexdii bilood ee ugu horreysay oo labanlaabmay
item.description: Manchester United ayaa 19 November shaacisay natiijada maaliyadeed ee saddexda bilood ee ku eg 30 September 2026, kuwaas oo muujinaya in dakhligu kordhay 4.1%, halka khasaaraha kadib canshuurta uu gaaray 18.1 milyan oo gini.

item.title: Anthropic oo suuqa Nasdaq ku biirtay, iibkeedii saamiyada ayaa noqday kii ugu weynaa taariikhda
item.description: Shirkadda sirdoonka macmalka ah ee Mareykanka Anthropic ayaa 19 November saamiyadeeda ka bilowday suuqa Nasdaq, kaddib markii ay iibisay 980 milyan oo saami oo midkiiba yahay 83 doollar, taasoo ka dhigtay iibka ugu horreeya ee ugu weyn taariikhda.

item.title: Premier League oo shaacisay taariikhaha xilli ciyaareedka 2027-28: 13 August ilaa 21 May
item.description: Premier League ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqday in xilli ciyaareedka 2027-28 uu bilaaban doono Jimce, 13 August 2027, wareegga ugu dambeeyana uu wada dhici doono Axad, 21 May 2028.

item.title: England oo kooxda bilowga ku soo celisay Furbank, Chessum iyo Atkinson ka hor kulanka New Zealand
item.description: Tababaraha England Steve Borthwick ayaa 19 November shaaciyay kooxda ka ciyaari doonta kulanka Sabtida ee New Zealand ee tartanka Nations Championship ee rugby-ga, isagoo dib ugu soo celiyay George Furbank, Ollie Chessum iyo Seb Atkinson.

item.title: Didier Digard oo shirkiisii ugu horreeyay ee Lens ka sheegay inuu doonayo inuu kooxda dib ugu soo celiyo jidka
item.description: Tababaraha cusub ee RC Lens Didier Digard ayaa 19 November qabtay shirkiisii jaraa'id ee ugu horreeyay, laba maalmood ka hor kulankiisa koowaad ee kooxda oo ay la ciyaarayso Toulouse wareegga 11-aad ee Ligue 1.

item.title: Ireland oo kabtanka Dan Sheehan u dhigtay lambarka 8 kulanka South Africa
item.description: Tababaraha Ireland Andy Farrell ayaa 19 November kabtanka kooxda Dan Sheehan u magacaabay booska lambarka 8 ee kulanka Sabtida ay Dublin kula ciyaarayaan horyaalka adduunka South Africa, tartanka Nations Championship ee rugby-ga.

item.title: Putin oo diiday wadahadal xabbad-joojin ah kaddib weerarrada Ukraine ee buundada Crimea
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay in Moscow aysan galayn wadahadal xabbad-joojin ah kaddib weerarrada Ukraine ay ku qaadday buundada Crimea, isagoo ballanqaaday jawaab uu ku tilmaamay mid aad uga xanuun badan.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka ee da'da ka yar 17 oo ka bilaabmay Qatar, 48 xul ayaa ka qaybgalaya
item.description: Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA ee ciyaartoyda da'doodu ka yar tahay 17 sano ayaa 19 November ka furmay Qatar, iyadoo 48 xul ay ka qaybgalayaan, in kasta oo Mareykanku toddobaadkii hore ka baxay tartanka walaac amni dartiis.

item.title: Kooxaha Premier League oo ogolaaday inay bixiyaan kharashka sharciga haddii taageerayaasha Man City ay dacwad furaan
item.description: Kooxaha Premier League ayaa 19 November London ugu codeeyay inay daboolaan kharashka sharciga ee shanta agaasime ee golaha ururka haddii shirkadaha maalgeliya Manchester City ay dacwad ka gudbiyaan.

item.title: Samia iyo Museveni oo Uganda ka furay warshad gaadiid culus oo 4,000 baabuur sannadkii soo saari karta
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan iyo Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa 19 November si wadajir ah u daahfuray warshadda isku-dubbaridka gaadiidka ee Double Q oo ku taalla Nakirebe, degmada Mpigi.

item.title: Hoggaamiyeyaal Yurub ah oo warqad cabasho ah u diray FIFA, kuna dalbaday dukumentiyada qorshihii Koobka Adduunka
item.description: Saddex ku-xigeen guddoomiye iyo shan xubnood oo ka tirsan Golaha FIFA ayaa warqad u diray xoghayaha guud ee FIFA Mattias Grafström, iyagoo dalbaday dukumentiyada qorshihii Gianni Infantino ee la xiriiray in qayb ka mid ah Koobka Adduunka loo wareejiyo maalgashadayaal gaar ah.

item.title: Messi oo qareenadiisa u maray ogeysiis rasmi ah oo uu AFA kaga codsanayo inay joojiso isticmaalka sawirkiisa
item.description: Lionel Messi ayaa la sheegay inuu qareenadiisa u diray Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Argentina (AFA) ogeysiis rasmi ah oo uu ku dalbanayo in sawirkiisa iyo magaciisa aan loo isticmaalin ujeeddooyin ganacsi iyada oo aan oggolaanshihiisa la helin.

item.title: Emiliano Martínez oo ku baaqay in la jaraynayo qiimaha tigidhada xulka Argentina kaddib ka tagitaankii Messi
item.description: Goolhayaha xulka Argentina Emiliano Martínez ayaa ku baaqay in la dhimo qiimaha tigidhada kulamada xulka, kaddib markii tirada taageerayaasha garoomada timaada ay hoos u dhacday labadii kulan ee ugu horreeyay tan iyo markii Lionel Messi uu xulka ka fariistay.

item.title: Real Madrid oo heshiiska Aurélien Tchouaméni u kordhisay ilaa 2032
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa Khamiistii si rasmi ah u shaacisay inay heshiiska khadka dhexe ee Faransiiska Aurélien Tchouaméni u kordhisay ilaa 30 June 2032.
